title: VtM5e Loresheets
description: Standalone Loresheet compendium - split out of vtm5e-disciplines, which had been used as a dumping ground for anything wod5e doesn't have a dedicated pack for. wod5e has no dedicated Loresheet item type, so these remain modeled as type: 'feature', featuretype: 'merit' (matching how the book itself describes Loresheets as functioning like a themed merit tree). Not published; built for personal use.
